label: Self-management
definition: Capacity to organize effort and behavior to pursue goals and meet responsibilities.

label: Social engagement
definition: Capacity to initiate, maintain and influence social interactions.

label: Cooperation
definition: Capacity to maintain positive relationships and work constructively with others.

label: Emotional resilience
definition: Capacity to regulate emotions and recover from challenging experiences.

label: Innovation
definition: Capacity to generate, understand and engage with new ideas and experiences.

label: Time Management
definition: Capacity to allocate time and meet deadlines effectively.

label: Organizational Skill
definition: Capacity to structure activities, materials and plans effectively.

label: Capacity for Consistency
definition: Capacity to maintain dependable and consistent behavior.

label: Task Management
definition: Capacity to initiate, prioritize and complete tasks.

label: Detail Management
definition: Capacity to attend to details and avoid errors.

label: Rule-following Skill
definition: Capacity to follow applicable rules and instructions.

label: Responsibility Management
definition: Capacity to fulfill obligations and commitments.

label: Goal Regulation
definition: Capacity to set goals and sustain goal-directed effort.

label: Decision-Making Skill
definition: Capacity to evaluate options and make considered decisions.

label: Leadership Skill
definition: Capacity to guide and coordinate other people.

label: Persuasive Skill
definition: Capacity to influence others through convincing communication.

label: Expressive Skill
definition: Capacity to communicate thoughts and feelings clearly.

label: Conversational Skill
definition: Capacity to initiate and sustain conversations.

label: Energy Regulation
definition: Capacity to mobilize and sustain energy when required.

label: Perspective-Taking Skill
definition: Capacity to understand another person's point of view.

label: Capacity for Trust
definition: Capacity to forgive others and recognize positive qualities in people.

label: Capacity for Social Warmth
definition: Capacity to express friendliness and interpersonal warmth.

label: Teamwork Skill
definition: Capacity to contribute effectively to collaborative work, as a BESSI skill.

label: Ethical Competence
definition: Capacity to act honestly and in accordance with ethical principles.

label: Stress Regulation
definition: Capacity to manage tension and remain effective under stress.

label: Capacity for Optimism
definition: Capacity to maintain a constructive outlook under difficulty.

label: Anger Management
definition: Capacity to manage anger and its expression.

label: Confidence Regulation
definition: Capacity to maintain appropriate confidence in demanding situations.

label: Impulse Regulation
definition: Capacity to restrain impulses when needed.

label: Abstract Thinking Skill
definition: Capacity to understand and work with abstract concepts.

label: Creative Skill
definition: Capacity to generate original ideas and solutions.

label: Artistic Skill
definition: Capacity to engage effectively in artistic expression.

label: Cultural Competence
definition: Capacity to understand and appreciate different cultural backgrounds.

label: Information Processing Skill
definition: Capacity to understand and work with information efficiently.

label: Self-Reflection Skill
definition: Capacity to examine one's thoughts, feelings and actions.

label: Adaptability
definition: Capacity to adjust thoughts and behavior to changing conditions.

label: Capacity for Independence
definition: Capacity to act and make choices without unnecessary reliance on others.

label: Task self-management
notes: these are scores given by judges after observing task-related performances
definition: Judge-rated self-management performance in observed tasks; retained historical BESSI-based task code.

label: Task social engagement
notes: Historical unsuffixed task code: observer rating. Attached self variant: self-rated performance in the same focal task. Both remain distinct from global BESSI ability self-concepts.
definition: social engagement performance in observed tasks; retained historical BESSI-based task code. The historical unsuffixed code denotes observer assessment; registered self denotes a self-appraisal of performance in the task.

label: Task cooperation
notes: Historical unsuffixed task code: observer rating. Attached self variant: self-rated performance in the same focal task. Both remain distinct from global BESSI ability self-concepts.
definition: cooperation performance in observed tasks; retained historical BESSI-based task code. The historical unsuffixed code denotes observer assessment; registered self denotes a self-appraisal of performance in the task.

label: Task emotional resilience
notes: Historical unsuffixed task code: observer rating. Attached self variant: self-rated performance in the same focal task. Both remain distinct from global BESSI ability self-concepts.
definition: emotional resilience performance in observed tasks; retained historical BESSI-based task code. The historical unsuffixed code denotes observer assessment; registered self denotes a self-appraisal of performance in the task.

label: Task innovation
notes: these are scores given by judges after observing task-related performances
definition: Judge-rated innovation performance in observed tasks; retained historical BESSI-based task code.

label: SECA Self-management
definition: Management of emotions and goal-directed behavior, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SECA Relationships
definition: Establishment and maintenance of relationships, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SECA Social awareness
definition: Awareness of others and social situations, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SECA Self-awareness
definition: Awareness of personal emotions and characteristics, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SECA Decision making
definition: Considered and responsible decision making, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SECA Self-concept
notes: Source score SECA_SA_StrengthsWeaknesses; called Self-Concept in the paper. Author-provided item-mean scores, original 1-4 scale; 249 observed of 322 released college records. Distinct from BESSI measures.
definition: SECA facet of awareness of personal strengths and weaknesses within Self-Awareness.

label: SECA Emotion knowledge
notes: Source score SECA_SA_EmotionKnowledge. Author-provided item-mean scores, original 1-4 scale; 249 observed of 322 released college records. Distinct from BESSI measures.
definition: SECA facet of understanding and identifying emotions within Self-Awareness.

label: SECA Emotion regulation
notes: Source score SECA_SM_EmotionRegulation. Author-provided item-mean scores, original 1-4 scale; 249 observed of 322 released college records. Distinct from BESSI measures.
definition: SECA facet of perceived capacity to regulate emotions within Self-Management.

label: SECA Goal management
notes: Source score SECA_SM_GoalManagement. Author-provided item-mean scores, original 1-4 scale; 249 observed of 322 released college records. Distinct from BESSI measures.
definition: SECA facet of perceived capacity to manage goals within Self-Management.

label: SECA School work
notes: Source score SECA_SM_SchoolWork. Author-provided item-mean scores, original 1-4 scale; 249 observed of 322 released college records. Distinct from BESSI measures.
definition: SECA facet of perceived capacity to manage school work within Self-Management.

label: MOSAIC Effort
definition: Sustaining effort toward goals, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: MOSAIC Connection
definition: Establishing and maintaining social connections, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: MOSAIC Getting along
definition: Getting along constructively with others, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: MOSAIC Composure
definition: Maintaining composure under difficulty, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: MOSAIC Open mind
definition: Engaging openly with ideas and experiences, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: Cognitive Reappraisal Skill
definition: Perceived capacity to reinterpret situations to regulate emotion, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: Emotional Reflection Skill
definition: Perceived capacity to reflect on emotional experiences, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: PSEC Assertiveness
definition: Perceived assertiveness, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: PSEC Tolerance
definition: Perceived tolerance of others, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: PSEC Social regulation
definition: Perceived regulation of social interactions, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: PSEC Emotion regulation
definition: Perceived regulation of emotions, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: PSEC Emotional awareness
definition: Perceived awareness of emotions, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: PSEC Total
definition: Overall perceived social-emotional competence, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SEL Self-management
definition: Management of personal behavior and effort, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SEL Mindset
definition: Mindset within the source SEL framework, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SEL Self-efficacy
definition: Perceived efficacy within the source SEL framework, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: SEL Social
definition: Social functioning within the source SEL framework, retaining the source framework rather than assuming equivalence to BESSI.

label: Conscientiousness skill (adapted BFI)
notes: 0014: BFI item adaptations with an ability stem; distinguish from both BFI trait ratings and BESSI domains. One base construct across informants and Likert/forced-choice formats; no score conversion or matrix creation.
definition: Perceived ability to act in organized, diligent and responsible ways, measured with an ability-framed Big Five adaptation.

label: Agreeableness skill (adapted BFI)
notes: 0014: BFI item adaptations with an ability stem; distinguish from both BFI trait ratings and BESSI domains. One base construct across informants and Likert/forced-choice formats; no score conversion or matrix creation.
definition: Perceived ability to act cooperatively and considerately, measured with an ability-framed Big Five adaptation.

label: Emotional stability skill (adapted BFI)
notes: 0014: BFI item adaptations with an ability stem; distinguish from both BFI trait ratings and BESSI domains. One base construct across informants and Likert/forced-choice formats; no score conversion or matrix creation.
definition: Perceived ability to remain emotionally stable and cope with difficulty, measured with an ability-framed Big Five adaptation.

label: Openness skill (adapted BFI)
notes: 0014: BFI item adaptations with an ability stem; distinguish from both BFI trait ratings and BESSI domains. One base construct across informants and Likert/forced-choice formats; no score conversion or matrix creation.
definition: Perceived ability to engage with ideas and experiences in open-minded ways, measured with an ability-framed Big Five adaptation.

label: Extraversion skill (adapted BFI)
notes: 0014: BFI item adaptations with an ability stem; distinguish from both BFI trait ratings and BESSI domains. One base construct across informants and Likert/forced-choice formats; no score conversion or matrix creation.
definition: Perceived ability to act sociably and assertively, measured with an ability-framed Big Five adaptation.

label: BF Openness
definition: Typical tendency toward intellectual curiosity, imagination and openness to experience.

label: BF Conscientiousness
definition: Typical tendency toward organization, diligence and responsibility.

label: BF Extraversion
definition: Typical tendency toward sociability, assertiveness and energetic engagement.

label: BF Agreeableness
definition: Typical tendency toward compassion, respect and interpersonal cooperation.

label: BF Neuroticism
definition: Typical tendency toward negative emotional experiences and emotional instability.

label: BF-E Sociability
definition: Big Five personality facet describing seeking and enjoying social interaction.

label: BF-E Assertiveness
definition: Big Five personality facet describing expressing influence and taking a leading role.

label: BF-E Energy
definition: Big Five personality facet describing typical vigor and energetic activity.

label: BF-A Compassion
definition: Big Five personality facet describing concern for others and their wellbeing.

label: BF-A Respectfulness
definition: Big Five personality facet describing considerate and respectful treatment of others.

label: BF-A Trust
definition: Big Five personality facet describing positive expectations about others intentions.

label: BF-N Anxiety
definition: Big Five personality facet describing typical anxiousness and worry.

label: BF-N Depression
definition: Big Five personality facet describing typical sadness and low positive mood.

label: BF-N Emotional volatility
definition: Big Five personality facet describing emotional instability and rapid negative reactions.

label: BF-C Organization
definition: Big Five personality facet describing order and systematic organization.

label: BF-C Productiveness
definition: Big Five personality facet describing persistence and effective completion of work.

label: BF-C Responsibility
definition: Big Five personality facet describing dependability and fulfillment of obligations.

label: BF-O Curiosity
definition: Big Five personality facet describing interest in ideas and learning.

label: BF-O Aesthetic
definition: Big Five personality facet describing sensitivity to art and aesthetic experiences.

label: BF-O Creativity
definition: Big Five personality facet describing imagination and originality.

label: HEXACO Honesty-humility
definition: HEXACO personality domain describing sincerity, fairness and avoidance of exploitation.

label: HEXACO Emotionality
definition: HEXACO personality domain describing fearfulness, emotional attachment and sensitivity.

label: HEXACO Extraversion
definition: HEXACO personality domain describing social confidence and energetic engagement.

label: HEXACO Agreeableness
definition: HEXACO personality domain describing patience, forgiveness and interpersonal accommodation.

label: HEXACO Conscientiousness
definition: HEXACO personality domain describing organization, diligence and prudence.

label: HEXACO Openness
definition: HEXACO personality domain describing curiosity and engagement with ideas and aesthetic experiences.

label: VIA Interpersonal
definition: Character-strength measure of strengths relevant to positive interpersonal functioning.

label: VIA Intellectual
definition: Character-strength measure of strengths relevant to intellectual engagement.

label: VIA Intrapersonal
definition: Character-strength measure of strengths relevant to personal functioning.

label: VIA Interpersonal control
definition: Character-strength measure of source-defined interpersonal-control strength composite.

label: VIA Social intelligence
definition: Character-strength measure of understanding people and social situations.

label: VIA Gratitude
definition: Character-strength measure of recognition and appreciation of benefits received.

label: VIA Zest
definition: Character-strength measure of enthusiastic and energetic engagement with life.

label: VIA Curiosity
definition: Character-strength measure of interest in exploring and learning.

label: VIA Academic control
definition: Character-strength measure of source-defined academic-control strength composite.

label: VIA Perseverance
definition: Character-strength measure of continued effort despite obstacles.

label: PYD Competence
definition: Positive youth development component describing perceived competence in relevant life domains.

label: PYD Confidence
definition: Positive youth development component describing positive self-regard and confidence.

label: PYD Character
definition: Positive youth development component describing standards of conduct and integrity.

label: PYD Caring
definition: Positive youth development component describing concern and empathy for others.

label: PYD Connection
definition: Positive youth development component describing positive connections to people and institutions.

label: Academic achievement
notes: includes general achievement measures or average of school grades
definition: Attainment in education, including grades, GPA and general academic-performance indicators; standardized tests have a separate code.
synonyms: GPA; grades; academic performance; school achievement

label: Standardized academic achievement
definition: Performance on standardized academic-attainment tests, distinguished from ordinary grades and GPA.
synonyms: standardized achievement test; standardized academic performance

label: Academic engagement
definition: Overall involvement and investment in academic activities.

label: Affective engagement
definition: Emotional involvement in learning and school or university activities.

label: Behavioral engagement
definition: Participation, effort and persistence in academic activities.

label: Cognitive engagement
definition: Mental investment and strategic processing devoted to learning.

label: Agentic engagement
definition: Proactive contribution to the conditions and direction of one's learning.

label: Academic self-efficacy
definition: Belief in one's ability to perform successfully in academic activities.

label: SRL strategies
definition: Reported use of strategies to plan, monitor and regulate learning.

label: Mastery learning goals
definition: Orientation toward developing competence and understanding rather than demonstrating relative ability.

label: Mathematical self-concept
notes: 0107: Q24 I am good at math; individual-item predictor, not an objective mathematics or intelligence test.
definition: Self-perceived ability or competence in mathematics.

label: Positive achievement emotions
definition: Positive emotions experienced in relation to learning, achievement activities or outcomes.

label: Negative achievement emotions
definition: Negative emotions experienced in relation to learning, achievement activities or outcomes.

label: Academic Satisfaction
definition: Satisfaction with school or university life and academic experiences.

label: Academic Burnout
definition: Exhaustion and disengagement associated with academic demands.

label: Test anxiety
definition: Anxiety experienced in anticipation of or during evaluative academic situations.

label: Test anxiety reduction strategies
definition: Reported strategies or regulation directed at reducing test-related anxiety, rather than anxiety level itself.

label: Educational aspiration
notes: the higher degree students want to reach
definition: Level of education or qualification a person wishes to attain.

label: Teacher autonomy support
definition: Perceived teacher support for students' choice, initiative and self-directed action.

label: Parent autonomy support
definition: Perceived parental support for choice, initiative and self-directed action.

label: School attendance
definition: Presence or attendance in scheduled school activities.

label: School discipline
definition: Conduct or disciplinary indicators in school; direction depends on the source measure.

label: Extracurricular participation
notes: 0014: number of extracurricular activities during a typical school year; no particular sport, artistic or volunteering activity is inferred.
definition: Participation or involvement in activities outside the regular school curriculum.

label: Student connectedness
notes: 0023: Student Connectedness scale; distinguish from peer acceptance, general life satisfaction and satisfaction with the institution.
definition: Sense of social connection, belonging and support within the student community.

label: Expected degree completion
notes: 0023: single-item likelihood1-10; an expectation rather than observed graduation, GPA or educational attainment.
definition: Self-estimated likelihood of completing the current degree or educational program.

label: Career adaptability
definition: Resources for managing career tasks, transitions and challenges.

label: Career concern
notes: CAAS resource in 0068: six-item mean, 1-5; retain overall adaptability separately.
definition: Future orientation and preparation for occupational tasks and transitions.

label: Career control
notes: CAAS resource in 0068: six-item mean, 1-5; retain overall adaptability separately.
definition: Responsibility, decisiveness and self-directed control in career choices and transitions.

label: Career curiosity
notes: CAAS resource in 0068: six-item mean, 1-5; retain overall adaptability separately.
definition: Exploration of possible careers and the fit between oneself and the working world.

label: Career confidence
notes: CAAS resource in 0068: six-item mean, 1-5; retain overall adaptability separately.
definition: Confidence in overcoming obstacles and solving problems in career development.

label: Job counterproductive behaviors
definition: Workplace behavior that harms an organization or its members.

label: Job citizenship behaviors
definition: Discretionary behavior that supports colleagues or organizational functioning.

label: Job satisfaction
definition: Evaluation of satisfaction with one's job or work experience.

label: Job relationships
definition: Quality of relationships with colleagues at work.

label: Enterprising personality
definition: Personality characteristics associated with initiative and enterprising activity, distinct from vocational interests.

label: Job performance
notes: Broad review construct. In0026 two distinct objective indicators are indexed once under this construct; no aggregate is computed. Matrix columns retain activity and sales separately.
definition: Performance or effectiveness in carrying out work tasks and achieving work outcomes.

label: Job performance - activity
notes: 0026 showing_center: properties shown per month employed, already centered within city. Activity/process indicator; do not average with sales performance.
definition: Recorded volume of work-related activity, adjusted as specified by the source.

label: Job performance - sales
notes: 0026 deal_center: properties sold per month employed, already centered within city. Outcome indicator; retain separately from activity.
definition: Recorded sales or completed transactions, adjusted as specified by the source.

label: Anxiety
definition: Anxious feelings, worry or anxiety symptoms outside a specifically coded context.

label: Social anxiety
definition: Anxiety or apprehension in social interactions or situations involving social evaluation.

label: Depression
definition: Depressive feelings or symptoms, rather than the Big Five depression facet.

label: Distress intolerance
definition: Perceived difficulty accepting or enduring distressing emotional states.

label: Emotion Controllability
definition: Beliefs about whether emotions can be controlled or changed; score direction follows the source.
synonyms: emotion controllability beliefs; beliefs about emotion control

label: Emotion usefulness beliefs
notes: 0128 EBQ usefulness: main article reports additional models in the supplement; supplementary coefficients have not been independently checked.
definition: Beliefs about the usefulness or functional value of emotions, distinct from their controllability.

label: Suppression strategies
definition: Use of strategies that inhibit the outward expression of emotion.

label: Reappraisal strategies
definition: Use of cognitive reinterpretation to change an emotional response, rather than perceived skill in doing so.

label: Mental health
definition: Broad mental-health or psychological-distress indicator; polarity must follow the study's coding.

label: Life satisfaction
definition: Cognitive evaluation of satisfaction with one's life as a whole.

label: Subjective wellbeing
definition: Broad subjective evaluation of wellbeing, potentially combining life satisfaction and affect.

label: Affective wellbeing
definition: Wellbeing defined through the quality or balance of emotional experiences.

label: Positive affect
definition: Frequency or intensity of positive emotional experiences.

label: Negative affect
definition: Frequency or intensity of negative emotional experiences.

label: Emotional reactivity
notes: 0014: single-item external criterion concerning the impact of setbacks on mood; distinct from nervousness/anxiety and perceived regulation ability.
definition: Extent to which events or setbacks affect emotional experience or mood.

label: Personal burnout
notes: 0027 German panel: adapted six-item Copenhagen Burnout Inventory personal-burnout subscale. Distinct from academic burnout and from job-specific burnout; review indexing only.
definition: General physical and psychological fatigue or exhaustion assessed as personal burnout.
synonyms: personal burnout; exhaustion; fatigue; Copenhagen Burnout Inventory

label: Physical exercise
definition: Participation or engagement in physical exercise or activity.

label: Physical health
definition: General physical health or physical-health status.

label: Social responsibilities
definition: Sense of responsibility toward other people and the wider community.

label: Volunteering
definition: Participation in voluntary activities intended to benefit others or the community.

label: Civic skills
definition: Abilities relevant to civic participation and public engagement.

label: Voting intention
definition: Stated intention or likelihood of voting.

label: Civic involvement
definition: Participation or involvement in civic and community activities.

label: Activism
definition: Action intended to promote social, political or environmental change.

label: Informal helping
definition: Helping others outside formal volunteering or organizational roles.

label: Altruism
definition: Concern for or willingness to benefit others, distinct from a specific BESSI skill.

label: Teamwork
definition: Orientation or behavior concerning collaborative work, distinct from the BESSI teamwork-skill score.

label: Rule Following
definition: Tendency or behavior involving adherence to rules, distinct from the BESSI rule-following skill.

label: Conditional cooperation (task)
notes: Proposed identifier change from conditionalcooperation; task suffix must be registered before integration.
definition: Cooperative responding contingent on others' contributions in a behavioral task; not the broad BESSI cooperation domain.

label: Interpersonal tolerance
notes: 0014: two external criteria concern getting along with different students and respecting disagreement. Index this broad construct once; do not average the two items or treat it as a BESSI/PSEC scale.
definition: Tolerance and respect for people with different backgrounds, characteristics or viewpoints.

label: Injunctive norms
notes: 0107: four PD appropriateness judgments, hypothetical and incentivized; indexed once without averaging across scenarios.
definition: Judgments of which actions are socially appropriate or ought to be performed.

label: Competitiveness
notes: 0107: two competition items enter individual-item regression/LASSO; not a BESSI cooperation skill.
definition: Preference or motivation to compete against others.

label: Action competence for sustainability
definition: Perceived competence to take informed action for sustainability, distinct from reported behavior.

label: Connectedness to nature
definition: Sense of connection, belonging or identification with the natural world.

label: Pro-environmental attitudes
notes: Mean of the seven environmental-attitude items; captures attitudes rather than behavior or sustainability competence
definition: Evaluations favoring environmental protection, distinct from behavior and sustainability competence.

label: Environmental motivation
notes: Mean of the three VEMI environment items; distinguished from connectedness to nature and reported behavior
definition: Motivation to engage with environmental causes or action.

label: Pro-environmental behavior
notes: Overall reported behavior index averaging goods transport engagement and the combined food dimension with source-defined scaling and weights
definition: Overall reported environmentally sustainable behavior across source-defined domains.

label: Pro-environmental behavior - goods
notes: Mean of the 12 goods-related sustainable-behavior items
definition: Environmentally sustainable behavior concerning goods and consumption.

label: Pro-environmental behavior - transport
notes: Mean of the five transportation-related sustainable-behavior items
definition: Environmentally sustainable transportation behavior.

label: Pro-environmental behavior - engagement
notes: Mean of the 11 engagement-related sustainable-behavior items
definition: Active engagement in environmentally sustainable practices or initiatives.

label: Pro-environmental behavior - food
notes: Source-defined equally weighted combination of two food-behavior items and six food-consumption items scaled to 1-5
definition: Environmentally sustainable food-related behavior and consumption.

label: Knowledge of action possibilities for sustainability
notes: SPACS resource in 0070: four-item mean, 1-5; retain overall action competence separately.
definition: Perceived knowledge of possible actions and perspectives relevant to sustainability.

label: Confidence in own influence on sustainability
notes: SPACS resource in 0070: four-item mean, 1-5; retain overall action competence separately.
definition: Belief that one can influence sustainable development in the community and beyond.

label: Willingness to act for sustainability
notes: SPACS resource in 0070: four-item mean, 1-5; retain overall action competence separately.
definition: Willingness and intention to act for sustainable development, distinct from reported behavior.

label: Climate-change beliefs
notes: 0107: Q76 and Q91; item-level analyses, no new total computed.
definition: Beliefs about the existence and human causes of climate change.

label: Climate-policy support
notes: 0107: Q78-Q79 and Q82-Q86; distinguish support/evaluation of climate policy from personal environmental action.
definition: Support for or evaluation of collective policies and institutional responses to climate change.

label: Environmental concern
notes: 0107: Q87 importance and Q89 attention to climate change, indexed once without pooling scores.
definition: Perceived importance of environmental problems and attention to those problems.

label: Environmental responsibility
notes: 0107: Q88 personal responsibility; distinguish responsibility from general motivation or actual action.
definition: Perceived personal responsibility to help address environmental problems.

label: Climate knowledge
notes: 0107: Q90 objective CO2-emission knowledge and Q92 self-assessed knowledge. Indexed once; methods remain distinct and no combined score is calculated.
definition: Objective or self-perceived knowledge about climate change and its causes.

label: Social dominance orientation
notes: SDO questionnaire item mean after reversals; higher scores represent greater preference for group-based dominance and inequality
definition: Preference for group-based social hierarchy and inequality.

label: Right-wing authoritarianism
notes: Mean of the 20 scored RWA items specified by the source after reversals; retain original 1-9 response metric
definition: Attitudes emphasizing submission to authority, conventionalism and authoritarian aggression.

label: Conservatism
notes: Overall mean of the social and economic conservatism scale after reversals; source metric 0-100
definition: Overall conservative orientation combining social and economic content.

label: Economic conservatism
notes: Mean of the five economic-conservatism items; distinguished from social conservatism
definition: Conservative attitudes toward economic policy and organization.

label: Social conservatism
notes: Mean of the seven social-conservatism items after reversals; distinguished from economic conservatism
definition: Conservative attitudes toward social norms and social policy.

label: Political orientation
notes: Single-item liberal-conservative self-placement; higher values denote greater conservatism
definition: Self-placement on a political or ideological orientation scale.

label: Peer acceptance
definition: Degree to which a person is accepted or liked by peers.

label: Social status
definition: Position, standing or status within a social group.

label: Friendship quality
definition: Quality of supportive and positive experiences within friendships.

label: Father relationships
definition: Quality of the relationship with one's father.

label: Mother relationships
definition: Quality of the relationship with one's mother.

label: Romantic relationships
definition: Quality or functioning of a romantic relationship.

label: Positive reciprocity
definition: Tendency to respond positively to beneficial treatment from others.

label: Negative reciprocity
definition: Tendency to retaliate against harmful or unfair treatment.

label: Trust
definition: General trust in others, distinct from perceived capacity to trust as a BESSI skill.

label: Grit
definition: Sustained perseverance and commitment toward long-term goals.

label: Epistemic curiosity
definition: Motivation to seek knowledge and resolve gaps in understanding.

label: Novelty seeking
notes: 0014: single-item external criterion concerning trying new ways of doing things; does not require risk taking.
definition: Tendency or preference to explore new experiences or try new ways of doing things.

label: Achievement striving
notes: 0014: single-item external criterion concerning challenging oneself to work harder; not a BESSI self-management score.
definition: Motivation or effort to challenge oneself and work harder toward achievement.

label: Purpose in life
notes: 0023: LET and PWB purpose subscale index the same broad construct once; the PWB subscale is not an overall wellbeing score.
definition: Sense of personally meaningful life direction, overarching goals and engagement in valued activities.
synonyms: sense of purpose; life engagement; purpose in life; LET

label: Growth mindset
definition: Belief that relevant personal attributes or abilities can develop.

label: Fixed mindset
definition: Belief that relevant personal attributes or abilities are relatively unchangeable.

label: Self-esteem
definition: General evaluation of one's worth or value.

label: Self-efficacy
definition: General belief in one's ability to manage demands and achieve intended outcomes.

label: Perceived similarity of traits and skills
notes: 0014: three directly analyzed similarity/distinction questions in Table 5. Index the broad construct once; no composite score is fabricated.
definition: Explicit beliefs or judgments about the similarity or distinction between personal traits and skills.

label: Procrastination
definition: Delay of intended action despite anticipated disadvantages.

label: Time discounting
definition: Relative valuation of outcomes available sooner versus later.

label: Risk taking
definition: Willingness or tendency to choose actions with uncertain outcomes and possible costs.

label: Interests - realistic
definition: Vocational interest in practical and hands-on activities, rather than ability or performance.

label: Interests - investigative
definition: Vocational interest in inquiry and analytical activities, rather than ability or performance.

label: Interests - artistic
definition: Vocational interest in creative and expressive activities, rather than ability or performance.

label: Interests - social
definition: Vocational interest in helping, teaching and interpersonal activities, rather than ability or performance.

label: Interests - enterprising
definition: Vocational interest in persuasion, leadership and business activities, rather than ability or performance.

label: Interests - conventional
definition: Vocational interest in structured, administrative and organizational activities, rather than ability or performance.

label: Behavioural Regulation Index
definition: BRIEF index of difficulties regulating behavior; not a general BESSI ability score.

label: Emotion Regulation Index
definition: BRIEF index of difficulties regulating emotional responses.

label: Cognitive Regulation Index
definition: BRIEF index of difficulties managing cognitive aspects of everyday executive functioning.

label: General Executive Functioning Composite
definition: BRIEF composite of everyday executive-function difficulties.

label: Complex problem-solving knowledge
notes: Mean accuracy across the eight Tailorshop knowledge item groups; distinct from simulated company performance
definition: Knowledge about a complex problem-solving system, distinct from performance in operating that system.

label: Complex problem-solving performance
notes: Final simulated company value at turn 12; source values below -300000 treated as missing; distinct from task knowledge
definition: Task performance in managing a complex simulated system, distinct from knowledge about the system.

label: Complex problem solving
notes: 0145: overall latent Tailorshop CPS construct combines task knowledge and simulated company performance. Keep the two observed components separately indexed when analyzed; no new observed composite or matrix column is generated.
definition: Ability to understand and manage complex,dynamic systems with interdependent variables and incomplete information.

label: Working Memory
definition: Ability to maintain and manipulate information over a short interval.

label: Inhibition
definition: Ability to suppress prepotent or inappropriate responses.

label: Flexibility
definition: Ability to shift mental sets or adapt processing to changing task demands.

label: Interference Control
definition: Ability to resist distraction or competing information.

label: Intelligence
definition: General cognitive ability represented by an overall intelligence score.

label: Crystallized intelligence
definition: Acquired knowledge and skills associated with crystallized cognitive ability.

label: Fluid intelligence
definition: Reasoning and problem solving with novel material.

label: Education level
definition: Educational attainment of the participant.

label: Parent education
definition: Educational attainment of participants' parents, coded according to the source.

label: Sex (F)
notes: 0 = male, 1 = female Study-specific exceptions are documented in sample notes, including the retained non-cis-man contrast in 0128.
definition: Study-coded sex or gender contrast, usually 0=male and 1=female; study-specific exceptions remain in sample notes.

label: Personal income
notes: 0027 German panel: own monthly net income in ordered categories, including no own income. Review indexing only; not household income, educational attainment or a computed SES composite.
definition: Personal monetary income, retaining the source period and coding.
synonyms: personal income; monthly net income; earnings

label: Addictive consequences of social networks
definition: Problematic or addiction-related consequences of social-network use.

label: Negative Social Comparison
definition: Negative comparison of oneself with others in social-network contexts.

label: Emotion regulation initiation
definition: Occurrence of an attempt to regulate emotions, distinct from frequency conditional on initiation.

label: Emotion regulation initiation frequency
definition: Frequency of emotion-regulation attempts within the source-defined observation window.

label: Pleasant situation
definition: Perceived pleasantness of the current situation.

label: Familiar situation
definition: Perceived familiarity of the current situation.

label: Controllable situation
definition: Perceived controllability of the current situation.

label: Social situation
definition: Presence of social interaction or other people in the situation.

label: Socially warm situation
definition: Perceived interpersonal warmth of the situation.

label: Socially dominant situation
definition: Perceived dominance in the social situation, distinct from ideological social dominance orientation.

label: Learning from experience
notes: 0095: presence of learning in coded volunteer reflections; not an objectively scored cognitive test or a separately assessed BESSI skill.
definition: Reported acquisition of knowledge,insight or understanding through participating in an activity.
synonyms: experiential learning; learning from volunteering; learning experiences

label: Change goals
definition: Desired or intended change in one's personality or related personal characteristics.

label: Preference for human vs digital assistance for change
definition: Preference for human versus digital assistance with personal change.

label: Willingness for digital assistance for change
definition: Willingness to use digital assistance for personal change.

label: Use of digital assistance for change
definition: Reported use or stage of use of digital assistance for personal change.

label: Perceived feasibility of personal change
notes: 0061: one-year conditional feasibility rating for each skill/trait definition; distinct from actual skill level,general self-efficacy and generic growth mindset.
definition: Belief about how much one could increase a personal characteristic over a specified period if one tried.
synonyms: change feasibility; perceived malleability; feasibility beliefs

label: Motivation for personal change
notes: 0061: explicit motivation-to-change item,analyzed separately from the desired amount of change. No behavioral attempt or achieved change is inferred.
definition: Self-reported motivation to increase or improve a specified personal characteristic.
synonyms: motivation to change; motivation toward change

label: Expected benefits of personal change
notes: 0061: expected life impact of increasing each skill/trait; neither observed life satisfaction nor actual skill utility/outcome effects.
definition: Anticipated improvement in life resulting from increasing a specified personal characteristic.
synonyms: expected change impact; anticipated benefits of change; perceived impact of change

label: Skill practice
notes: 0108: accepted and completed behavioral challenges, across domains and waves, indexed once without combining the different source measures. Distinct from merely wanting change.
definition: Commitment to and enactment of concrete activities intended to improve personal skills.
synonyms: behavioral challenges; skill practice; challenge completion

label: Interest in change interventions
notes: 0144: teachers rate their own workshop interest; parents rate willingness to allow their child to participate. Keep the role-specific targets distinct; no actual attendance or skill change is measured.
definition: Interest in or openness to engaging in an organized intervention intended to change skills or personal characteristics.
synonyms: workshop interest; intervention acceptance; willingness to participate
